title: 自检心流
note: 读自己的心：贪嗔痴、五盖、掉举、疑

evidence.pali: ‘‘Sace pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti – ‘lābhīmhi ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassa, lābhī adhipaññādhammavipassanāyā’ti, tena, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā tesuyeva kusalesu dhammesu patiṭṭhāya uttari āsavānaṃ khayāya yogo karaṇīyo.
evidence.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，若有比丘省察时，自知：‘我已得内心之寂止，已得增上慧法观。’诸比丘，彼比丘当安住于彼等善法，为进一步灭尽诸漏而勤勇行。”
evidence.english: But if, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu, on reviewing, knows thus: ‘I am a gainer of internal serenity of mind, and I am a gainer of insight into phenomena through higher wisdom,’ then, bhikkhus, that bhikkhu, being established in these very wholesome qualities, should make a further effort for the destruction of the taints.

entries.pali: 1040 . Adhipatiṃ karitvā ti ārammaṇādhipatiṃ katvā. Te ca kho parittadhammāva honti. Ariyasāvakānañhi attano maggaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhaṇakāle ārammaṇādhipati labbhati. Cetopariyañāṇena pana ariyasāvako parassa maggaṃ paccavekkhamāno garuṃ karontopi attanā paṭividdhamaggaṃ viya garuṃ na karoti. ‘Yamakapāṭihāriyaṃ karontaṃ tathāgataṃ disvā tassa maggaṃ garuṃ karoti na karotī’ti? Karoti, na pana attano maggaṃ viya. Arahā na kiñci dhammaṃ garuṃ karoti ṭhapetvā maggaṃ phalaṃ nibbānanti. Etthāpi ayamevattho. Vīmaṃsādhipateyya nti idaṃ sahajātādhipatiṃ dassetuṃ vuttaṃ. Chandañhi jeṭṭhakaṃ katvā maggaṃ bhāventassa chando adhipati nāma hoti, na maggo. Sesadhammāpi chandādhipatino nāma honti, na maggādhipatino. Cittepi eseva nayo. Vīmaṃsaṃ pana jeṭṭhakaṃ katvā maggaṃ bhāventassa vīmaṃsādhipati ceva hoti maggo cāti. Sesadhammā maggādhipatino nāma honti. Vīriyepi eseva nayo.
entries.chinese_simplified: 1040. ‘作增上’是说作所缘增上。而那些法只是欲界法。因为圣弟子在省察自己的道并视之为重时，便得所缘增上。但圣弟子以他心智省察他人之道时，即使尊重它，也不会像尊重自己所证悟的道那样。‘见到如来示现双神变时，是否尊重他的道？’尊重，但不如尊重自己的道。阿罗汉除了道、果、涅槃之外，不尊重任何法。此处也是此义。‘以审查为增上’——这是为了显示俱生增上而说。因为对以欲为首要而修习道的人来说，欲被称为增上，而不是道。其余的法也名为欲增上法，而非道增上法。于心也是同样的方法。但对以审查为首要而修习道的人来说，审查既是增上，也是道。因此，其余的法名为道增上法。于精进也是同样的方法。
entries.english: 1040. `Having made it the dominant factor` means having made it the object-dominant factor. And those states are only limited ones. For it is when noble disciples review their own path, giving it weight, that the object-dominant factor is obtained. But when a noble disciple reviews another's path with the knowledge of others' minds, even though he gives it weight, he does not give it weight in the same way as his own penetrated path. 'When one sees the Tathāgata performing the Twin Miracle, does one give weight to his path or not?' One does, but not in the same way as to one's own path. An arahant gives no weight to any state except the path, the fruit, and Nibbāna. Here, too, this is the meaning. The phrase 'dominance of investigation' is stated to show the conascence-dominant factor. For one who develops the path making zeal foremost, zeal is the dominant factor, not the path. The other states are called 'zeal-dominant,' not 'path-dominant.' The same principle applies to consciousness. But for one who develops the path making investigation foremost, investigation is the dominant factor, and the path is as well. The other states are called 'path-dominant.' The same principle applies to energy.

entries.pali: Idāni tamatthaṃ kāraṇena sādhento taṃ kissa hetū tiādimāha. Tassattho, tattha siyā tumhākaṃ, kasmā so bhikkhu bhagavato pujjataro ca pāsaṃsataro cāti? Tañhi tassā ti yasmā taṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkhipanaṃ tassa bhikkhuno dīgharattaṃ appicchatāya…pe… vīriyārambhāya saṃvattissati. Kathaṃ? Tassa hi sace aparena samayena paccayesu atricchatā vā pāpicchatā vā mahicchatā vā uppajjissati. Tato naṃ iminā piṇḍapātapaṭikkhepaṅkusena nivāressati ‘‘are tvaṃ sugatātirittampi piṇḍapātaṃ paṭikkhipitvā īdisaṃ icchaṃ uppādesī’’ti evaṃ paccavekkhamāno. Esa nayo asantuṭṭhiyā asaṃlekhassa cuppannassa nivāraṇe. Evaṃ tāvassa appicchatāya santuṭṭhiyā saṃlekhāya saṃvattissati.
entries.chinese_simplified: 现在，为以理由成就其义，世尊说了以‘彼是何因’等开头的文句。其义为：你们心中可能会想：‘为何那位比丘于世尊而言更值得尊敬与赞扬呢？’（答：）‘因为那对他’是指：因为那拒绝食物之举，将长久地为那位比丘带来少欲……乃至……发起精进。如何带来？若他在未来对资具生起过度欲、恶欲或大欲，届时，当他如此省察：‘你这人！连善逝所余之食都拒绝了，如今竟生起此等欲望？’便能以此拒绝食物之钩制止自己。此理亦适用于制止已生起的不满足与不简朴。如是，此举首先将为他成就少欲、知足与简朴。
entries.english: Now, establishing that matter with a reason, he said, 'For what reason?' and so on. Its meaning is: Your thought might be, 'Why is that monk more to be honored and more to be praised by the Blessed One?' Because that rejection of the almsfood will, for a long time, conduce to that monk's fewness of wishes... (etc.)... to the rousing of energy. How so? If, for him, at a later time, in regard to the requisites, there should arise covetousness, or evil wishes, or great wishes, then, reflecting thus, 'Friend, having rejected even the remainder-almsfood from the Sugata, do you give rise to such a wish?', he will restrain himself with this goad of having rejected the almsfood. This is the method for restraining arisen discontent and lack of austerity. Thus, it will conduce to his fewness of wishes, contentment, and austerity.

entries.pali: Tattha sace aparena samayena assa attano vā upaṭṭhākānaṃ vā dubbharatānayena cittaṃ uppajjissati. Tato naṃ iminā piṇḍapātapaṭikkhepaṅkusena nivāressati – ‘‘are tvaṃ sugatātirittampi piṇḍapātaṃ paṭikkhipitvā īdisaṃ cittaṃ uppādesī’’ti evaṃ paccavekkhamāno, evamassa subharatāya saṃvattissati. Sace panassa kosajjaṃ uppajjissati, tampi etenevaṅkusena nivāressati – ‘‘are tvaṃ nāma tadā sugatātirittampi piṇḍapātaṃ paṭikkhipitvā tathā jighacchādubbalyaparetopi samaṇadhammaṃ katvā ajja kosajjamanuyuñjasī’’ti evaṃ paccavekkhamāno, evamassa vīriyārambhāya saṃvattissati. Evamassa idaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkhipanaṃ dīgharattaṃ appicchatāya…pe… vīriyārambhāya saṃvattissati. Evamassime pañca guṇā paripūrā dasa kathāvatthūni paripūressanti.
entries.chinese_simplified: 于此，如果后来他自己或其护持者生起难以奉养之心，他将以此拒绝团食之钩制止：‘喂！你连善逝所余之食都拒绝了，竟然还生起此心！’如是省察，此将有助于他成为易奉养者。如果生起懈怠，亦以此钩制止：‘喂！你那时连善逝所余之食都拒绝了，虽为饥饿软弱所困，仍修习沙门之法，今天却耽于懈怠！’如是省察，此将有助于他发起精进。这样，他拒绝团食之举，将长久地有助于少欲……乃至发起精进。这样，他的这五种功德圆满，便能圆满十种论事。
entries.english: In that regard, if at a later time a thought should arise in that monk by way of being difficult to support, either on his own account or on account of his supporters, then this goad of refusing the alms-food will restrain him. Reflecting thus: 'O you! Having refused even the Sugata's leftover alms-food, have you now given rise to such a thought of being difficult to support?' In this way, it will conduce to his being easy to support. If, however, laziness should arise in him, that too will be restrained by this very goad. Reflecting thus: 'O you! At that time, having refused even the Sugata's leftover alms-food and practiced the ascetic's duty even though afflicted by hunger and weakness, do you now indulge in laziness?' In this way, it will conduce to his arousal of energy. Thus, for him, this refusal of alms-food will, for a long time, conduce to fewness of wishes... to the arousal of energy. In this way, for him, these five qualities, being fulfilled, will fulfill the ten topics of discourse.

entries.pali: 1040 . Yasmiṃ sabhāvadhamme ninnapoṇapabbhārabhāvena cittaṃ pavattati, so tassa ārammaṇādhipati veditabbo. Cetopariyañāṇena jānitvā paccavekkhamāno tena paccavekkhamānoti vutto. Etthāpī ti etasmimpi aṭṭhakathāvacane, ettha vā paṭṭhāne maggādīni ṭhapetvā aññesaṃ adhipatipaccayabhāvassa avacaneneva paṭikkhepapāḷiyaṃ. Ayamevattho ti attano maggaphalaṃ ṭhapetvāti attho. Vīmaṃsādhipateyya nti padhānena adhipatinā sahajātādhipati nidassito, tayidaṃ nayadassanamattameva hotīti aññopi evaṃpakāro sahajāto maggādhipati nidassito hoti, tasmā vīriyādhipateyyanti ca yojetabbaṃ. Idampi hi atthato vuttamevāti.
entries.chinese_simplified: 1040. 心以何自性法为低倾、趋向、倾斜而转起，彼法即应知为彼心之所缘增上。以他心智了知后而省察者，被称为“以彼而省察者”。“于此亦然”者，谓于此义注之语中，或于此《发趣论》(Paṭṭhāna)中，因不言说置除道等之外的其他诸法有增上缘性，故为遮止之巴利文。“此即是义”者，义谓“置除自己的道与果”。以“慧增上”(vīmaṃsādhipateyya)一词，是以主要之增上指示了俱生增上；彼此语仅是显示方法而已，因此其他如此种类的俱生道增上亦被指示。是故，亦应结合“精进增上”(vīriyādhipateyya)。因为此亦实义上已被说。
entries.english: 1040. That intrinsic phenomenon in which the mind proceeds with a state of inclination, bending, and sloping, should be known as the object-dominance for that mind. Having known by means of the knowledge of others' minds, one who reviews is said to be 'one who reviews by means of that'. Here too—in this commentary statement, or here in the Paṭṭhāna—in the Pāḷi of rejection, the rejection is conveyed by the very non-statement of the state of being a dominance-condition for others, excluding the path and so forth. This is the meaning: 'excluding one's own path and fruition'. By 'investigation-dominance,' co-nascent dominance is indicated by means of the principal dominant factor. This is merely an illustration of the method; thus, another co-nascent path-dominance of this kind is also indicated. Therefore, 'energy-dominance' should also be connected. For this too is indeed stated by way of meaning.

entries.pali: Lābhasakkārasilokahetu sambhāvanādhippāyena saṃyatākāradassanaṃ kohaññanti āha ‘‘pāpicchatāya niratthakakāyavacīvipphandaniggahaṇaṃ koraja’’ nti. Yo saṃvegabahulo kukkuccako pubbenāparaṃ attanopi kiriyaṃ parisaṅkanto paccavekkhamāno tiṭṭhati, tādisaṃ viya attānaṃ dassento ‘‘atiparisaṅkito’’ ti vutto.
entries.chinese_simplified: 为求利养、恭敬、名声，怀着被尊重的意图，展现出克制的样态，即是欺骗(kohañña)。如说：“因恶欲而抑制无意义的身语活动，即是伪善(koraja)。”有人多有悚惧，多有追悔，不断省察并怀疑自己前后的行为而住，（另一人）却展现出自己如同此人一般，这被称为“过度审慎”。
entries.english: He says that 'hypocrisy' (kohañña) is the showing of a restrained demeanor with the intention of being esteemed on account of gain, honor, and fame. He says, 'craftiness' (koraja) is the suppression of useless bodily and verbal activity out of evil desire. One who is full of spiritual urgency and scrupulous, who stands reflecting on his own action, suspicious of the latter because of the former, showing himself to be like that, is called 'overly suspicious.'

entries.pali: Ekavāraṃ pavattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkhipanaṃ kathaṃ dīgharattaṃ appicchatādīnaṃ kāraṇaṃ hotīti codanaṃ sandhāyāha ‘‘tassa hī’’ tiādi. Tattha atricchatā ti atra icchatīti atriccho, tassa bhāvo atricchatā, atthato paralābhapatthanā. Tathā hi vuttaṃ ‘‘purimeyeva sakalābhena asantuṭṭhi, paralābhe ca patthanā, etaṃ atricchatālakkhaṇa’’nti (vibha. aṭṭha. 849). Pāpicchatā ti asantaguṇasambhāvanādhippāyatā. Pāpā icchā etassāti pāpiccho, tassa bhāvo pāpicchatā. Yathāha ‘‘asantaguṇasambhāvanatā paṭiggahaṇe ca amattaññutā, etaṃ pāpicchalakkhaṇa’’nti (vibha. aṭṭha. 851). Mahantāni vatthūni icchati, mahatī vā tassa icchāti mahiccho, tassa bhāvo mahicchatā . Yaṃ sandhāya vuttaṃ ‘‘santaguṇasambhāvanatā paṭiggahaṇe ca amattaññutā, etaṃ mahicchalakkhaṇa’’nti. Paccavekkhamāno nivāressatīti yojanā. Assa bhikkhuno saṃvattissati piṇḍapātapaṭikkhepo.
entries.chinese_simplified: “一次拒绝托钵食物，如何能长久成为少欲(appicchatā)等品质的原因？”针对此质问而说“tassa hi”(对他而言)等。此处，“贪求无厌”(atricchatā)是指于此贪求(atra icchati)，即为“贪求者”(atriccho)，其状态是“贪求无厌”，义为希求他人之利养。如是说：“于先前所得不满足，又希求他人之利养，此为贪求无厌之相”(Vibha. Aṭṭha. 849)。“恶欲”(pāpicchatā)是指意图彰显不实的功德。有恶欲者为“恶欲者”(pāpiccho)，其状态即是“恶欲”。如言：“彰显不实的功德，且在接受供养时不知量，这是恶欲的特征”(Vibha. Aṭṭha. 851)。欲求众多事物，或其欲望巨大者，为“大欲者”(mahiccho)，其状态即是“大欲”(mahicchatā)。针对此说：“彰显已有的功德，且在接受供养时不知量，这是大欲的特征”。应当省察而制止，这是此处的关联。对该比丘而言，拒绝托钵将能促成（其少欲等品质）。
entries.english: Addressing the question, 'How can the rejection of almsfood, even if it occurs just once, be a cause for fewness of wishes and so on in the long term?', he said: 'for him indeed,' and so on. Herein, atricchatā (excessive desire): one who desires excessively is an atriccha; the state of that person is atricchatā, which in essence is the longing for others' gain. For thus it is said: 'Dissatisfaction with one's own gain already obtained, and longing for others' gain—this is the characteristic of excessive desire' (VibhA. 849). Pāpicchatā (evil desire) means the intention of making known non-existent virtues. One whose desire is evil is a pāpiccha; the state of that person is pāpicchatā. As it is said: 'The making known of non-existent virtues and immoderation in receiving—this is the characteristic of evil desire' (VibhA. 851). One who desires great things, or great is their desire, is a mahiccha (one with great desire); the state of that person is mahicchatā (great desire). Regarding which it was said: 'The making known of existent virtues and immoderation in receiving—this is the characteristic of great desire.' The connection is that by reflecting, one will restrain these qualities. For that monk, the rejection of almsfood will conduce to this.
